description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to contribute to a peaceful, cohesive, secure and inclusively developed BARMM (Bangsamoro Autonomous Region of Muslim Mindanao), supporting the new transitional authority government to enable a democratic governance environment for a smooth implementation during the transition and the first two years of the future elected government. The project is funded by the EU and UNOPS will be responsible for logistics, procurement, and infrastructure for key components. The programme includes a provision for infrastructure assessment, design, and implementation services to enhance the physical facilities to support the capacity building and delivery of services. The first part of the programme contains an inception phase during which the infrastructure needs will be explored, and the infrastructure scope will be defined.
